obligation.exact_statement: Prove or correct the four-statistical-head causal construction for all K>=2,N>=3 under D1-D5, including two paid singleton-mask predecessor/endpoint heads, query-independent values, the initial flag and actual endpoint correction, recovered normalizers, and no free pair/triple table. Give a specified finite-precision neural implementation of scores/softmax, selection, multiplication/division, clipping and add-one exact-simplex finite output, complete R and parameter/working-bit/operation bounds distinguishing O(K) alphabetic interface from full neural resources. Prove a uniform theta-independent implementation schedule and max-context almost-sure consistency for every fixed generally nonuniform stationary strictly positive D1 law, with actual terminal expected and conditional-terminal consequences. Independently check/correct the checkpoint's pathwise 35eta+6zeta joint-frequency and smoothed-TV bounds. This is C1 plus its deterministic error prerequisite, not closure of C2-C4.

assumptions: D1-D8 are the exact current stage scope; theta is unknown and no parameter depends on the test law.
Stationary strictly positive second-order sources; uniform finite-N claims explicitly declare their additional class bounds.
All side information, positions, endpoint access, finite arithmetic, residuals and program/parameter storage are charged.
Binary product kernels map to the earlier sign-B kernel as inD2; categorical extension and complete-contextA stay distinct.
Copied prior material is provenance and must undergo this project native evidence path when used as an admitted premise.

quantifiers.domain: D3-D5 causal simplex family indexed byN andaccuracy, with theta-independent accuracy schedule
stationarily initialized strictly positive second-order tables

scope.parameter_domain: K integers>=2; N integers>=3; theta asD1; proposed gamma=kappa=1, lambda1=1,lambda2=2, all fixed independent ofN andtheta; comparatorA fixed beta>0 subject to the same declared score-range budget; epsilon>0 and alpha in(0,1); finite resources asD5; any enlarged coefficient/error/source domain must be explicitly proved.
